Itaru Nakamura, who will be appointed as the head of Japan's police force on Sept. 22, is the man who called off the arrest of Noriyuki Yamaguchi in the case of the quasi-rape of a female journalist. 
We are against that appointment.
#Metoo
#中村格氏の警察庁長官就任に抗議します

In Japan, where discrimination against women is strong, no self-purification can be expected. Pressures from the outside is necessary. Foreign news outlets, please report on the unsuitability of Itaru Nakamura as the Commissioner of the Metropolitan Police Department.
#Metoo
